## Overview

This captured [[braintree]] Node.js-routed response-reference page is a sparse Apple Pay Options availability stub. Its only substantive statement says that, at the captured snapshot, only Braintree's PHP and Ruby SDKs support managing domains for Apple Pay on the web via the API.

## Key takeaways

- The page identifies an Apple Pay Options route under the Node.js response-reference path, but the captured body does not document a response object, fields, field constraints, invocation, return value, or runtime behavior.
- The availability statement is narrowly scoped to managing domains for Apple Pay on the web via Braintree's API and names only the PHP and Ruby SDKs. It must not be generalized to all Apple Pay configuration or to native Apple Pay.
- This is a 2026-09-16 website snapshot, not proof of current SDK support, merchant eligibility, domain registration, completed configuration, or successful payment execution. The linked JavaScript v3 configuration page is navigation only for this entry.
